To: support@clockpoint.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: kevin.mutua@tausifreight.example
Subject: Re: [CP-48213] Overtime coding issue on night shifts

Dear Faith,

Thank you for picking this up. Here are the details you asked for. I have copied Kevin Mutua, our payroll officer, who will test any fix you suggest.

1. Terminal model and firmware: BX-300. The four terminals at our Embakasi depot auto-updated from 4.1.8 to 4.2.1 on the night of 27 October. The two at our Mombasa Road depot are still on 4.1.8, and their day shift exports are correct.

2. Shift template: NIGHT-8 (22:00 to 06:00), Embakasi depot. 38 staff are affected.

3. Example: staff ID T-0417 clocked in at 21:54 on 30 October and out at 06:07 on 31 October.
- The export showed 2.1 hrs REG on 30 October and 6.1 hrs OT15 on 31 October.
- We expected 8.0 hrs REG plus 0.2 hrs OT15. Payroll rounds to the nearest tenth of an hour, so the 8 h 13 min total is 8.2 hrs, and the 13 minutes outside the scheduled shift are coded OT15.

In short, any shift crossing midnight is now split into two lines, and the after-midnight line is coded OT15 instead of REG.

4. Export profile: Payroll CSV v2.

5. When we noticed: the problem appears to have started around 28 October, straight after the update. We only spotted it on 5 November, while reviewing the draft October overtime, which came out about KES 212,000 too high. Kevin has corrected it manually from the raw punches.

The 4.2.1 release notes promised improved midnight rollover handling, so we were surprised to see the opposite.

Two things we need from you:

- Can Brian Ochieng, who manages our terminals, safely roll the Embakasi terminals back from 4.2.1 to 4.1.8 without losing any punch data? Please answer yes or no, and tell us what precautions he should take.
- If a rollback is not advised, what fix or workaround do you recommend? Our November payroll inputs close on 20 November, so we need something we can rely on before then.

Kevin can test as soon as you have something for us.

Kind regards,
Njeri Mwangi
HR Manager, Tausi Freight
